purpose: Evaluate predictive and fee-adjusted trading value, not semantic path-label accuracy
requirements: Register one new candidate artifact, features and parameters before observing future outcomes
Fit all preprocessing and calibrators on training-only data with matured labels
Freeze baseline and candidate predictions before T auction, retain trusted publication receipts and full candidate universe
Use exactly the same candidate universe, fill rules, fee policy and exit labels
Retain pending, missing, no-fill and holding records separately; never silently drop unresolved losses
Evaluate both seats and an equal-time cohort, not selected profitable days
Predeclare one formal endpoint review; do not repeatedly test until positive
Use day-block paired uncertainty and correct for all registered comparisons
Require both seats to improve, withstand cost stress and avoid degradation concentrated in one market regime
Any post-registration model change restarts the forward cohort
Source/model/rule integrity and operational acceptance are separate gates
Activation remains a separate reviewed action even if statistical criteria pass
